claim: Repository is a Spring Boot REST API that evaluates JSON-defined rules against arbitrary JSON input data.
notes: README describes purpose and operator set; corroborated by controller/service code.

claim: Build system is Maven with Spring Boot 3.2.5 parent, Java 17 target, spring-boot-starter-web, spring-boot-starter-validation, jackson-databind, and spring-boot-starter-test (test scope).
notes: No other runtime dependencies (no DB driver, no security starter, no messaging).

claim: Spring Boot application entrypoint is RuleEngineApplication.main, launched via SpringApplication.run.
notes: Standard @SpringBootApplication bootstrap class.

claim: HTTP endpoint POST /api/v1/rule-engine/evaluate accepts {data, rule} and returns {result: boolean} by delegating to RuleEngineService.evaluate.
notes: Single REST controller in the repository; base path /api/v1/rule-engine.

claim: EvaluateRequest requires non-null data (Map<String,Object>) and rule (JsonNode); validation triggered via @Valid and jakarta.validation @NotNull.
notes: EvaluateResponse wraps a single boolean 'result' field.

claim: GlobalExceptionHandler maps IllegalArgumentException and MethodArgumentNotValidException to HTTP 400 with {error, message} body; no handler for other exception types is present.
notes: README claims 422 for validation errors but code returns 400 for MethodArgumentNotValidException; documentation/code mismatch.
conflicts: README.md states 422 Unprocessable Entity for validation failures, but GlobalExceptionHandler.handleValidation returns HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST (400).

claim: RuleEngineService.evaluate implements group logic: object with 'all' -> AND (short-circuit on first false), 'any' -> OR (short-circuit on first true), 'not' -> negation of nested rule; a bare array is treated as an implicit AND group; otherwise the object is treated as a leaf condition.
notes: Empty group array returns the AND/OR identity value (true for all, false for any) per evalGroup line 43.

claim: Condition operators supported: eq, ne, lt, lte, gt, gte, between, in, contains, regex, exists, not_exists, isNull, isNotNull, implemented in evalCondition via the Operator enum.
notes: Unknown operator strings throw IllegalArgumentException('Unknown operator').

claim: Value comparison (compare) coerces both sides to BigDecimal for numeric comparisons, falls back to Instant.parse for ISO-8601 strings, then to Comparable, then to String comparison.
notes: BigDecimal conversion via Number.doubleValue() can lose precision for very large longs/doubles (potential edge-case bug).

claim: Field paths are resolved by splitting on '.' and walking nested Map<String,Object> structures; non-Map intermediate values cause path resolution to return null (field not found).
notes: No support for array indexing in field paths (e.g., 'items.0.name' is not handled).

claim: Main.java under org.example is an IDE-generated scratch/demo class (Hello World with loop) unrelated to the Spring Boot application; it is not wired to any Spring context and is a separate main method from RuleEngineApplication.
notes: Contains IntelliJ tutorial TIP comments; safe to ignore for business/architecture purposes but present in source tree.

claim: RuleEngineServiceTest contains 7 unit tests covering eq, gt+contains combined with 'all', 'any' short-circuit false, between+regex combined, exists/not_exists, isNull, and isNotNull.
notes: No dedicated tests found for ne, lt, lte, gte, in, or 'not' group operator, or for malformed-rule error paths (400s).

claim: RuleEngineControllerTest contains 1 Spring MockMvc integration test that posts a simple gte rule to /api/v1/rule-engine/evaluate and asserts HTTP 200 with result=true.
notes: No controller-level tests found for validation failures (null data/rule), malformed operators, or exception-handler behavior.

claim: Full test suite executes successfully: 8 tests run (7 in RuleEngineServiceTest, 1 in RuleEngineControllerTest), 0 failures, 0 errors.
commands: mvn -q -DskipTests=false test -> exit 0; Tests run: 7, Failures: 0, Errors: 0 (RuleEngineServiceTest); Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0 (RuleEngineControllerTest)
notes: Executed locally with Java 25/26 toolchain despite pom targeting Java 17; build succeeded without profile errors.

claim: The singularity/ directory (workflow.yml, portfolio.yml, personas/, templates/, prompts/) is Singularity Flow SDLC governance tooling, not application source code or a runtime dependency of the rule engine.
notes: Not inspected further as it is out of scope for application architecture/business/security views.

claim: No authentication or authorization mechanism is present anywhere in the source tree; spring-boot-starter-security is not a dependency; the /evaluate endpoint is unauthenticated and open to any caller who can reach it.
notes: No SecurityConfig, no filters, no API keys, no CORS configuration found in repository.

claim: The regex operator compiles a user-supplied pattern string from the request body directly via Pattern.compile and matches it against field data with no timeout or pattern-complexity guard, creating a potential regular-expression denial-of-service (ReDoS) surface for untrusted callers.
notes: Inferred risk based on code inspection; no test or configuration proves or disproves exploitability at scale.

claim: The service is stateless: no database, cache, message queue, or file persistence dependency exists in pom.xml or source; each /evaluate call is a pure function of the posted data and rule.
notes: No application.properties/application.yml file found under src/main/resources.

claim: No explicit logging statements, metrics, health-check endpoints (e.g., actuator), or observability configuration are present in the source tree; only default Spring Boot startup logging is observed at runtime.
commands: mvn test output shows only Spring Boot framework startup INFO logs, no application-level logging
notes: spring-boot-starter-actuator is not a dependency.
